data.raw_text:
i’ve booked 1,123+ b2b calls by being EXTREMELY SALESY in cold outreach

direct
straightforward

never:
“building trust”
or “hiding my intentions”

let me explain why "not selling" on the first touchpoint is cope:

THE VALUE-FIRST TRAP

everyone preaches this same slop:

1. "don't pitch immediately help them first"
2. "build relationships before pitching"
3. "be authentic in your outreach"
4. "give before you ask"
5. "lead with value first"

trust me they’re broke
only booking 3 calls per month

being authentic doesn’t print

it never did

buyers don't want friends
they want SOLUTIONS

they can see through your fake rapport and smell a pitch from a mile away

leads aren’t dumb anymore

they know what’s up

when someone opens your cold email

they're not thinking:

"i really hope this person is awesome"
"maybe we’ll be best friends
"this is gonna be cool"

they’re thinking HOW can you benefit them in any way

if yes: they're interested
if no: they delete and move on

your "authenticity" means NOTHING

THE VALUE-FIRST DISASTER SEQUENCE

here’s the issue with a value-first approach:

DAY 1: YOU SEND "FREE VALUE"

"hey [name]"

"i put together a free audit of your email system"

"it’s slightly broken and but you can to fix it like this:"

they reply: "thanks man appreciate this"

DAY 3: YOU SEND MORE "VALUE"

"hey [name]"

"also noticed these 3 angles working in your space"

"thought you'd want to know"

they reply: "cool stuff thanks for sharing"

DAY 7: YOU FINALLY PITCH

"hey [name]"

"would love to hop on a call"

"we can implement this for you"

then they ghost you completely
because they already fixed their stuff

they milked you dry
used your "value"

THE FAKE FRIEND COLD DM APPROACH

this one is even worse

i’ve had people ask me in dms:

"hey dimitar"

- "what's your biggest struggle with outbound right now?"
- "what's your current approach to getting clients?"
- "what's keeping you from hitting your goals?"

stop with this fake qualifying BS

i know exactly what you're doing

you’re "connecting with the lead”
you’re "understanding my needs"

but really you're just trying to find an angle to pitch me

you're pretending to care about my answers
when you just want to sell me something

brokie

anyone can spot this lmao

being authentic = being inauthentic

every single guy just forces it TOO much
so start saying what you ACTUALLY want instead

"we help [type of company] book 20-30 calls monthly"

"we do it through cold email"
"want to see how?"

that's MORE authentic than your "free value"

THE BAIT AND SWITCH

i tested this out for a month
this is what you’re all doing

and it’s AWFUL

it goes like this:

MESSAGE 1: "here's free value for you"
MESSAGE 2: "here's more free insights"
MESSAGE 3: "btw want to buy my service?"

prospect's response to message 3:

"wait hold on"

"i thought you were just trying to help me for free"

you've completely burned the relationship

because:

THEY DIDN'T CONSENT TO A SALES PROCESS

they thought you were genuinely being helpful

turns out you were warming them up for a pitch

now they feel manipulated and stupid

and that's if they didn't ghost you already

(because no real biz owner has time to go on 10+ back and forth DMs with you)

THE DIRECT APPROACH THAT ACTUALLY WORKS

then i tried out another method
i’ve actually been using this for a while

it printed me a lot this january

"hey [name]"

"help [type of company] book [specific result] in [timeframe]"

"figured you might want similar results"

"interested in seeing the breakdown?"

if they say yes: send them details & pitch
if they say no: move on to next prospect

no games
no fake value
no pretending to be friends

just direct benefit-focused communication

OBVIOUSLY you'll need more volume

but i can guarantee results will endu up better too

it’s how business should be done

"but they’ll think i’m rude"
"they will think i’m too pushy"

ghey

you’re doing business
business men care about $$$

so they want and value CLARITY

THE QUALIFICATION DISGUISE

this is the absolute worst version
i already mentioned it in the post too

but let’s go a bit deeper

stop pretending to qualify
when you're really just pitching

"what's your current monthly revenue?"
"what's your biggest bottleneck right now?"
"what have you tried so far that hasn't worked?"

stop interrogating people like you're doing research

if you want to pitch them JUST PITCH THEM

don't disguise it as "getting to know their business"

it’s the fakest bs you can do
anyone with a brain notices it

i always leave these guys on read

YOU BUILD TRUST BY DELIVERING ACTUAL RESULTS

not by giving away free tips in a cold email

i've signed clients who:

just saw my offer
never received any free value from me
liked the outcome i promised bought immediately

they trust me because i have real case studies
not because i sent them a free audit

lol

that even makes you look weaker

you’re positioning yourself as inferior

like a random VA from manila

if you wanna build trust

JUST DO CONTENT MARKETING

you post publicly
this builds trust and authority

but that's INBOUND not OUTBOUND

completely different game

so stop pretending
stop giving value

any real 6-7 figure business owner respond 10 times better to being straightforward

you're not their friend
you're a business trying to make money

SO YOU BETTER OWN THAT

and stop being a puss

- dimitar

(otherwise you'll continue to live and die broke)
